am.R: ለመሪዎቻችሁ ሁሉና ለእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሰላምታዬን አድርሱልኝ።

hi.L: अपने सब अगुवों और सब पवित्र जनों को नमस्कार कहो।
hi.B: अपने सब अगुवों को और परमेश्वर के सब पवित्र लोगों को नमस्कार कहो।
hi.R: अपने सब अगुवों को और परमेश्वर के सब लोगों को मेरा नमस्कार कहना।

ru.L: Приветствуйте всех ваших руководителей и всех святых.
ru.B: Приветствуйте всех ваших руководителей и весь Божий святой народ.
ru.R: Передайте мой привет всем вашим руководителям и всему Божьему народу.

uk.L: Вітайте всіх ваших провідників і всіх святих.
uk.B: Вітайте всіх ваших провідників і весь святий Божий народ.
uk.R: Передайте мої вітання всім вашим провідникам і всьому Божому народові.

ja.L: あなたがたのすべての指導者たちと、すべての聖なる者たちに、よろしく伝えなさい。
ja.B: あなたがたの指導者たち全員と、神の聖なる民全員に、よろしく伝えなさい。
ja.R: みなさんの指導者たちみんなと、神の民みんなに、よろしく伝えてください。

decisions.choice: saints: God's holy people, all believers
decisions.reason: ἁγίους are those set apart for God; the author has called the readers "holy brothers and sisters" (3:1) and spoken of their service to the saints (6:10).

decisions.choice: pass on greetings to all
decisions.reason: The letter may have been read first in one house church, whose members are asked to pass on greetings to the wider church and its leaders.

decisions.choice: saints (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "the saints" are.

decisions.choice: "पवित्र जनों" (L); "पवित्र लोगों" (B); "परमेश्वर के ... लोगों" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Acts and Romans: the holy ones are all of God's people.

decisions.choice: святых (L); Божий святой народ (B); Божий народ (R)
decisions.reason: As in Romans 16:15.

records.literal_gloss: Greet you those from the Italy.

en.L: Those from Italy greet you.
en.B: Those from Italy send you their greetings.
en.R: The believers from Italy send you their greetings.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saludan los de Italia.
es.B: Los de Italia {{plural_you:les|os}} envían saludos.
es.R: Los creyentes de Italia {{plural_you:les|os}} mandan saludos.

fr.L: Ceux d’Italie vous saluent.
fr.B: Ceux d’Italie vous envoient leurs salutations.
fr.R: Les croyants d’Italie vous envoient leurs salutations.

sw.L: Wale wa Italia wanawasalimu.
sw.B: Wale wa Italia wanawatumia salamu zao.
sw.R: Waumini wa Italia wanawatumia salamu.

vi.L: Những người từ Y-ta-li chào anh chị em.
vi.B: Những người từ Y-ta-li gửi lời chào anh chị em.
vi.R: Các tín hữu từ Y-ta-li gửi lời chào anh chị em.

ko.L: 이탈리아에서 [온] 사람들이 여러분에게 문안합니다.
ko.B: 이탈리아 사람들이 여러분에게 안부를 전합니다.

pt.L: Os da Itália saúdam vocês.
pt.B: Os da Itália mandam saudações a vocês.
pt.R: Os irmãos na fé da Itália mandam saudações a vocês.

am.L: ከኢጣሊያ ያሉት ሰላም ይሏችኋል።
am.B: ከኢጣሊያ የሆኑት ሰላምታ ይልኩላችኋል።
am.R: ከኢጣሊያ የሆኑት አማኞች ሰላምታ ይልኩላችኋል።

hi.L: इटली के लोग तुम्हें नमस्कार कहते हैं।
hi.B: इटली के लोग तुम्हें नमस्कार भेजते हैं।
hi.R: इटली के विश्वासी तुम्हें नमस्कार भेजते हैं।

ru.L: Приветствуют вас те, [кто] из Италии.
ru.B: Вам передают привет те, кто из Италии.
ru.R: Верующие из Италии передают вам привет.

uk.L: Вітають вас ті, що з Італії.
uk.B: Ті, що з Італії, передають вам вітання.
uk.R: Віруючі з Італії передають вам вітання.

ja.L: イタリアからの人々が、あなたがたによろしくと言っています。
ja.B: イタリアからの人たちが、あなたがたによろしくと言っています。
ja.R: イタリアの信者たちが、みなさんによろしくと言っています。

decisions.choice: those from Italy: either Italians away from home, or people in Italy
alternatives: Italians living outside Italy who send greetings home
believers in Italy sending greetings from there
decisions.reason: ἀπὸ can mark where people come from ("people who come from Italy") or where they are ("the people in Italy"). If the first, the author is outside Italy with Italian believers, and the letter may be going to Italy, perhaps to Rome. If the second, it is written from Italy. The earliest writing known to use Hebrews, 1 Clement, was sent from the church in Rome late in the first century.

decisions.choice: The believers (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that these are fellow believers.

decisions.choice: wa Italia
decisions.reason: "Wa Italia" (of Italy) leaves open both readings in m1; "kutoka Italia" or "walio Italia" would choose one.

decisions.choice: "những người từ Y-ta-li"
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean Italians away from home or people in Italy (m1); "từ Y-ta-li" keeps it open as the Greek does. "Y-ta-li" is the Protestant form of the name.

decisions.choice: "이탈리아에서 [온] 사람들" (L); "이탈리아 사람들" (B); "이탈리아의 믿는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean Italians away from home or people in Italy (meaning decision, uncertain and footnoted). Literal brackets the verb Korean needs; Balanced and Readable use the genitive, which leaves both readings open.

decisions.choice: "ኢጣሊያ" (Italy)
decisions.reason: ኢጣሊያ is the form of the Amharic Bible (Acts 18:2; 27:1); the everyday ጣሊያን is understood but is not the biblical spelling.

decisions.choice: "イタリアからの人々" (L, B), "イタリアの信者たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether these are Italians away from home or people in Italy (uncertain); "からの" and plain "の" keep both readings.

source.text: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: The grace [be] with all of you.

en.L: Grace [be] with all of you.
en.B: Grace be with all of you.
en.R: May God's grace be with all of you.

es.L: La gracia [sea] con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: La gracia sea con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Que la gracia de Dios esté con todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: La grâce [soit] avec vous tous.
fr.B: Que la grâce soit avec vous tous.
fr.R: Que la grâce de Dieu soit avec vous tous.

sw.L: Neema [iwe] pamoja nanyi nyote.
sw.B: Neema iwe pamoja nanyi nyote.
sw.R: Neema ya Mungu iwe pamoja nanyi nyote.

vi.L: Ân điển [ở] với tất cả anh chị em.
vi.B: Nguyện ân điển ở với tất cả anh chị em.
vi.R: Cầu xin ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời ở với tất cả anh chị em.

ko.L: 은혜가 여러분 모두와 함께 [있기를 빕니다].
ko.B: 은혜가 여러분 모두와 함께 있기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 하나님의 은혜가 여러분 모두와 함께 있기를 빕니다.

pt.L: A graça [seja] com todos vocês.
pt.B: A graça esteja com todos vocês.
pt.R: Que a graça de Deus esteja com todos vocês.

am.L: ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር [ይሁን]።
am.B: ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን።
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን።

hi.L: अनुग्रह तुम सब के साथ [हो]।
hi.B: अनुग्रह तुम सब के साथ हो।
hi.R: परमेश्वर का अनुग्रह तुम सब के साथ रहे।

ru.L: Благодать — со всеми вами.
ru.B: Пусть благодать будет со всеми вами.
ru.R: Пусть Божья благодать будет со всеми вами.

uk.L: Благодать з усіма вами.
uk.B: Благодать нехай буде з усіма вами.
uk.R: Нехай Божа благодать буде з усіма вами.

ja.L: 恵みが、あなたがたすべてと共に[ありますように]。
ja.B: 恵みが、あなたがたすべてと共にありますように。
ja.R: 神の恵みが、みなさん全員と共にありますように。

decisions.choice: the letter ends without "Amen" (the SBLGNT reading)
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts add "Amen", as the King James Version has it; some early ones do not. Later manuscripts also add notes saying where the letter was written, which are not part of the text. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: grace: God's free favor, the letter's closing wish
decisions.reason: The same short blessing closes Titus 3:15. Grace is where the letter has pointed throughout (4:16; 12:15; 13:9).

decisions.choice: God's (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says whose grace.

decisions.choice: the closing blessing in the form of Romans 16:24: "... तुम सब के साथ [हो] (L), हो (B), रहे (R)"
decisions.reason: The closing blessing keeps one form across the letters at each level. Hebrews ends without "Amen" (meaning decision m1), so none is added.
